status: placement-approved-before-tuning; role targets proposed fitting centers
authority: latest designer numerical-role instruction, canonical r31 manual histories/mechanics, existing authored fixed events
units: gross incoming damage across completed creature lifetime as percent of initial player maximum HP, never per hit; report net loss after regeneration separately

rules.fighters: 10–50 percent, rising with depth and explicit constraints; point targets are fitting centers, not survival promises
rules.skirmishers: 60–80 percent matched-depth Fighter output; preserve real mobility
rules.mages: about half matched-depth Fighter total output including bursts and residuals
rules.controllers_supports: low direct damage and gradual one-note restriction/heal utility; paired differential tests, not attack-only claim
rules.summoners: ten normal turns between casts; three actual casts worth one matched Fighter via children, include descendant summons in group tests
rules.legacy: r29/30/31 actors, generation, saves and replay unchanged
rules.prose: no descriptions or authored Natural History edits
rules.reference: all previously collected ordinary hearts and starter weapon per existing benchmark; moving ranges changes progression distributions, so regenerate reference profiles before fitting
rules.target_depth: Earliest reachable natural or conditional appearance; approved original midpoint retained only for diagnostics. Fixed per-species stats; later weaker encounters are expected.
rules.group_warning: solo targets do not sum into group outcomes, preserve pair/spawn/habitat/pack/caps and report group death rates
